newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Chronology of train accidents in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of train accidents in Pakistan.

text.p: A train crash near Khanewal in Pakistan's central province of Punjab on Monday killed at least 50 people and injured about 100 on Monday, police and doctors said.
Following is a list train accidents in Pakistan in the last 10 years:
Jan 3, 1990 - A passenger train ploughs into a stationary freight train at Sangi railway station in Sindh, killing 307 people and injuring 400. A judicial inquiry blames human error.
June 8, 1991 - Fifty-five people are killed and 150 injured when a Tezgam Express train hits a freight train standing at Ghotki station in Sind after an error by a signalman.
June 21, 1991 - Five passengers are killed and 12 injured when a low bridge sweeps them off the roof of a train in the dark near Jhimpir, 120 km (75 miles) north of Karachi.
Aug 29, 1991 - Karachi-bound Super Express is derailed when it hits a freight train being shunted at Piran Ghaib Station near Sargodha, killing six people and injuring 90.
Nov 1, 1992 - Seventeen people are killed and 44 injured when the Chenab Express from Karachi rams into the back of a wheat train in Reti, 470 km (290 miles) north of Karachi.
April 3, 1994 - Twelve people are killed and 40 injured when a passenger train is derailed near Sohawa, about 60 km (35 miles) southwest of Islamabad.

Jan 21, 1997 - Nine people, including six children and two teachers, are killed when an express train hits a school van on an unmanned level crossing near Gujar Khan, 60 km (37 miles) south of Islamabad.
